cost_sets.description: Per-dataset, per-model measured constants. Each set: family-level costs {c, L, rho, C, p, d, q0} per layout, plus the manifest tax {m, tau0} and the cache price ratio r (reference only).

r_cache.description: official cache-read/input price ratio; reference only (units are already cache-adjusted tokens)

m.description: manifest tokens per library entry; tau(n) = m*n + tau0

tau0.description: fixed part of the routing tax per arrival (from d_full; 0 until measured)

C_fullread.description: optional LLM-readin compile variant, reported alongside

p.description: gate pass rate; 0 is legal and means the family can never be compiled (8 of the 14 t16_build cells)

k_table.description: Optional C(k), p(k) for a compiler that reads k demonstrations: {"3": {"C_scale": 1.4, "p_scale": 1.0}}. The largest key <= k applies. Prefer the _scale form: the price ladder overwrites an absolute C.

C_fail.description: tokens for an attempt that MISSES the gate; absent, C_fail = C * C_fail_mult (sim.C_FAIL_DOC)

C_fail_mult.description: C_fail / C. The price ladder overwrites C, so the multiplier is the form that survives a price sweep. Measured placeholder for the build batch: 3

pi.description: fraction of the k demonstrations that succeeded, known before the first compile attempt; read by the pi-stratified gate prior (sim.GATE_PRIOR_DOC)

C.description: null = native: keep each cost set's own measured C

epsilon_cliff.description: Selection-failure cliff eps(n) = eps0 * sigmoid((n - cliff_start)/cliff_slope); q(n) = eps(n) + (1-eps(n))*q0. Measured eps = 0 for n<=100, so the headline runs keep enabled=false; E8 sweeps it.

path.description: repo-relative path for wiki_jsonl ({ts, family_id} per line)

key.description: entry key inside the old real_streams.json

window.description: first N arrivals after sorting by ts; null/absent = full

trigger.description: Algorithm 1 mechanism settings for 'ours' (the deployed configuration).

horizon_cap.description: expected uses a program can serve (old engine Theorem 2: 1/h at h=0.02 -> 50); the capped horizon modes clip the projection to it when the legacy h = 0

gate_prior.description: how p_hat is estimated. 'true' hands the policy the family's real p (historical default, keeps every published cell); 'add_one' is Algorithm 1's (passes+1)/(attempts+2); 'pi' stratifies the Beta prior by the demonstration success rate

buy_formula.description: how the trigger turns p_hat into the attempt's buy price (sim.BUY_FORMULA_DOC). 'full' = Algorithm 1's B_hat = C + (1/p_hat - 1)*C_fail (default since W1.5, 2026-09-19; at C_fail = C it evaluates C/p_hat exactly, so rows without a measured C_fail_mult are unchanged); 'narrow' = the pre-W1.5 C/p_hat for bitwise reproduction

spend_cap.description: attempt-spend cap: stop attempting once the tokens burned on FAILED attempts reach spend_cap_mult times the family's current expected saving (sim.SPEND_CAP_DOC)

deployment.description: Optional deployment options (router, library residency, minimum demonstrations). Absent keys fall back to the defaults in sim.py, which are the measured full-listing router, a monotone library and the one-demonstration compiler. Only the E4_crn / E4_evict / E4_retrieval / E4_kmin3 experiments read this block.

retrieval_router.description: tau = tau0 + m*min(k,n); keys k, eps_select, eps_recall_per_decade, n_ref, eps_max, eps_enabled.

hierarchical_router.description: tau = 2*tau0 + m_g*G + m*ceil(n/G) at G = sqrt(n*m/m_g); key m_group (null means m_g = m).

eviction.description: Residency bound. T is a number of stream arrivals or the string 't_star' for T* = (1/lambda) ln(C_eff*lambda/m); v_min is the evidence floor, t_min/t_max clip T*.

k_min_demo.description: Demonstrations the compiler needs; 1 is the deployed protocol and is inert.
